about: Stop reason codes (#881): why a task failed or was cancelled, as the settings window shows it in its language. The bot logs a code after its English stop line (agent/reasons.py), the runner sends its own and the bot's in the task event (runner/protocol.py), and the window fills {name} with the code's params (gui/src/reasons.ts). A reason with no code shows its English text. A code's params are the {name} placeholders of its sentences, the same in both languages. The webhook and logs/ keep the English text.

ClientOutdated.zh_tw: 遊戲版本過舊。到 Play 商店更新遊戲，再按「開始」。
ClientOutdated.en_us: The game client is out of date. Update it from the Play Store, then press Start again.

HomeInBattle.zh_tw: 遊戲正在戰鬥中。手動結束戰鬥，再按「開始」。
HomeInBattle.en_us: A battle is on. End it by hand, then press Start again.

DownloadOff.zh_tw: 遊戲要下載資料，但「自動接受下載與更新」是關閉的。
DownloadOff.en_us: The game asks to download data, but "Accept downloads and updates" is off.

UpdateOff.zh_tw: 遊戲有更新，但「自動接受下載與更新」是關閉的。
UpdateOff.en_us: The game has an update, but "Accept downloads and updates" is off.

UpdateRepeats.zh_tw: bot 啟動後，遊戲已經要求更新 {times} 次。
UpdateRepeats.en_us: The game asked for an update {times} times since the bot started.

TermsOff.zh_tw: 遊戲要同意使用者條款，但「自動同意使用者條款」是關閉的。
TermsOff.en_us: The game shows the User Agreement, but "Accept the User Agreement" is off.
